reasoning_content: The HTML is serving the Vite dev server (src="/src/main.tsx", "/@vite/client") — this is the development frontend, which is expected in run-dev mode. Let's verify that /src/main.tsx is being served, and check the PWA's manifest.json. Also, let's find the backend routes using a different grep.

action.command: for p in /src/main.tsx /manifest.json; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$p: %{http_code} (size %{size_download})\n" -H 'Host: localhost' "http://localhost:3000$p"; done; curl -s -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/manifest.json | head -c 300; echo; grep -oE '"/[a-z0-9_{}/-]+"' /workspace/backend/server/src/routes/*.rs 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -40 || find /workspace/backend/server/src -name '*.rs' | xargs grep -l 'Router' | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "for p in /src/main.tsx /manifest.json; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"$p: %{http_code} (size %{size_download})\\n\" -H 'Host: localhost' \"http://localhost:3000$p\"; done; curl -s -H 'Host: localhost' http://localhost:3000/manifest.json | head -c 300; echo; grep -oE '\"/[a-z0-9_{}/-]+\"' /workspace/backend/server/src/routes/*.rs 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -40 || find /workspace/backend/server/src -name '*.rs' | xargs grep -l 'Router' | head -5", "summary": "Verify Vite dev assets and PWA manifest, list routes"}
